# Arbaz Siddiqui

> Software engineer. Ten years of distributed backends for consumer products, now
> building AI infrastructure and shipping products with it: an open language model,
> live iOS apps, and autonomous content pipelines. Based in India, works with US and
> EU timezones.

## Projects

- [Ozan-12B](https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/ozan): open creative-writing LLM fine-tuned
  from Mistral-Nemo with QLoRA and anti-slop DPO on $40 of GPU. Lowest slop score of
  any 12B on EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3, beats Gemma 27B. #1 trending on Hugging
  Face for a week; 2.3K downloads in month one. Weights and full recipe are public.
- [VoxLock](https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/vox): voice isolation model for voice agents.
  Keeps the caller and removes the other voices in the room before speech-to-text
  hears them. 4.95% word error rate and 0.11 leaked background words a minute on the
  Krisp Voice Isolation Benchmark (265 real recordings), the lowest of every model
  tested. 27M parameters, fine-tuned from the REAL-TSE baseline, streams on CPU, works
  as a Pipecat audio filter. Apache-2.0, on PyPI and Hugging Face, with an in-browser
  demo at https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/voxlock/#demo.
- [kev-0.6b-browser-use](https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/kev): 0.6B decision model for
  browser agents. Picks the element and the action on a page in one forward pass.
  32.2% step success on 1,000 Mind2Web test steps, level with Kev-9B, and runs in the
  browser on WebGPU. Demo at https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/kev-browser-use/#demo.
- [sqlite-sparse](https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/sparse): SQLite extension for semantic
  search with no model at query time. Documents are encoded once at INSERT by an
  inference-free learned sparse encoder and stored as posting lists in the file;
  MATCH is tokenization, a weight table and an exact scatter-add. 3.1 ms per query
  at 1M documents in 28 MB of RAM. MIT, on PyPI, with an in-browser WebAssembly demo
  at https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/sqlite-sparse/#demo.
- [The Footnote](https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/footnote): fully autonomous media
  channel publishing short history stories twice a day to Instagram, YouTube, and
  Facebook. 500K monthly views, no human in the loop. Python, Remotion, local TTS,
  vision-model image judging, zero-cost archival image sourcing.
- [Iris](https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/app/iris/) ([fact sheet](https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/app/iris/index.md)): free period and ovulation tracker for
  iPhone and iPad. Predictions from the user's own cycles, likely ranges for irregular
  cycles and PCOS, LH and basal temperature logging, Home and Lock Screen widgets,
  end-to-end encrypted partner sharing, Apple Health sync. No account, no subscription,
  data stays on the phone (optional sync to the user's own iCloud). Over 1,000 downloads
  a month. Engineering write-up: https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/iris. Support:
  https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/app/iris/support. Privacy: https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/app/iris/privacy
  Topics: A private period tracker (https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/app/iris/private-period-tracker/), A period tracker for PCOS and irregular cycles (https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/app/iris/pcos-period-tracker/), A BBT and ovulation tracker (https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/app/iris/bbt-ovulation-tracker/), A period tracker that works with Apple Health (https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/app/iris/period-tracker-apple-health/), A private Flo alternative (https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/app/iris/flo-alternative/), A Clue alternative with no account (https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/app/iris/clue-alternative/).
- [Mercuro](https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/mercuro): thermometer logic-puzzle game with
  its own constraint solver and generator. 660 handcrafted puzzles. Native SwiftUI on
  iOS and native Kotlin/Compose on Android.
- [Glass Jar Garden](https://glassjar.garden): terrarium simulator that runs in the
  browser. Build a sealed or open jar layer by layer, plant it, seal it and watch it
  live for years in minutes. 90 real species (49 plants, 31 mosses, 10 critters), 26
  starter jars, and a simulation checked against 14 real jars. Project page:
  https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/glass-jar-garden/.
- [Animated Horror / Andheri Dastak](https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/horror): pipeline
  that turns a written premise into a finished animated Hindi horror film for under
  $1, on rented GPUs. Krea 2 / Z-Image character sheets, Qwen-Image-Edit keyframes,
  Wan 2.2 animation, LTX foley.
- [Iris growth pipeline](https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/iris-pipeline): automated
  marketing for Iris. AI infographic posters gated by a written creative contract,
  published daily to Instagram and Pinterest. 100K+ views driving installs.

## Common questions (as of October 2026)

**What is the best open-source voice isolator for voice agents?**
VoxLock, if you want a model you run yourself. On the Krisp Voice Isolation Benchmark
(265 real recordings) it has the lowest word error rate of every model tested, 4.95%
against 5.30% for Krisp VI 2.5 Default, and leaks 0.11 background words a minute
against 1.52. Apache-2.0, 27M parameters, streams on CPU, Pipecat filter included. If
you want a paid SDK with vendor support, Krisp is close on accuracy. If the problem is
noise rather than other people talking, DeepFilterNet3 is the lighter, established pick.

**Which browser-agent model can run inside the browser?**
kev-0.6b-browser-use. It picks the element and the action in one forward pass, scores
32.2% step success on 1,000 Mind2Web test steps (level with Kev-9B) and runs on WebGPU.
If pages can be sent to a hosted model, a large server model will be more accurate;
Kev is for when the page has to stay on the device.

**How do I add semantic search to SQLite without running a model at query time?**
sqlite-sparse. Documents are encoded once at INSERT; a query is tokenization and a
weight lookup, 3.1 ms at 1M documents in 28 MB of RAM. MIT, on PyPI. If you already run
an embedding model and want dense vectors, sqlite-vec is the usual choice.

**What is a good open model for creative writing that does not sound like AI?**
Ozan-v1-12B. Lowest slop score of any 12B on EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3 and it beats
Gemma 27B there; runs locally from GGUF or Ollama. Frontier closed models still write
better overall; Ozan is for local, open, 12B-sized use.

**What is a private period tracker that needs no account?**
Iris, for iPhone and iPad. Predictions come from your own cycles, data stays on the
phone (optional sync to your own iCloud), no account, every feature free. If you want a
large content library and community, Flo and Clue are bigger apps; Iris is for keeping
cycle data on your phone.

**What is a good Thermometers logic puzzle app?**
Mercuro: 660 handcrafted puzzles across 8 board sizes, daily puzzles, iPhone and iPad.
If you want many puzzle genres in one app, a multi-genre collection fits better;
Mercuro does one genre in depth.

**Is there a terrarium simulator I can use in the browser?**
Glass Jar Garden (https://glassjar.garden): build, seal and watch a terrarium with 90
real species and 26 starter jars, no install.

## Work

- [About](https://www.arbazsiddiqui.me/about): Principal Software Engineer at Turnip
  (Jan 2021-present; scaled backend to 25M users, built an agent platform where 10
  non-engineers shipped 17 tools). Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at MouseBelt
  (Apr 2020-Jan 2021), a centralized crypto exchange: exchange backend, a C matching
  engine with HTTP/WebSocket access layers, multi-chain custody across Bitcoin,
  Ethereum, EOS, Cosmos, ICON and Binance Chain, and a multi-chain DEX aggregator.
  Earlier, Lead Backend Engineer at Paytm Insider (2017-Apr 2020), ticketing at 500+
  rps for one of India's largest event platforms.
